title: The founding and unification of the Sui
subtitle: One starting point for the time slice
shortSummary: The founding and unification of the Sui provides political context for Sui–Tang institutions, capitals and networks of knowledge.
curatorialDescription: The event record supplies dates and institutional context; it does not treat political unification as a single cause of religious convergence or urban life.
researchNote: Founding, unification, capital changes and reforms need to be split into separate events with official-history and geographic sources.
